name: mirrorfrog.com AI Compute Cards Wiki - Ascend 310P / Enflame T21 pages
notes: LOW TRUST - an AI-generated-looking community wiki, used ONLY as a pointer to figures that need better sourcing and as an explicit record of what the unsourced number is. The Ascend 310P page gives 140-176 TOPS INT8 and ~70 TFLOPS FP16 with no citation at all. The Enflame T21 page is more candid about its own limits and marks FP16, INT8, memory capacity and bandwidth as '未公开（推测）' / unpublished-and-speculated. Treat every number here as a rumour that this repo records as vendor_claim: false at confidence 0.3-0.4.
